name: Route
abstract: A route: a road or path, described as a feature with a length in metres and a line geometry.

examples.title: Riverside route in Valencia
examples.content: A short route of two separate segments, with its length in metres.

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: Route
description: A route is a GeoJSON feature with a MultiLineString geometry and a length
  in metres.
type: object
allOf:
- $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/bblocks/annotated-schemas/geo/features/feature/schema.yaml
- properties:
    geometry:
      properties:
        type:
          const: MultiLineString
    properties:
      type: object
      required:
      - length
      properties:
        length:
          type: number
          exclusiveMinimum: 0
          description: Length of the route, in metres.
        name:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable name of the route.
  required:
  - geometry
  - properties
x-bblocks-metadata:
  itemIdentifier: iso.bbr.sample.jag.route
  register: https://avillar.github.io/bblocks-nov10-jag/build/register.json
  version: '0.1'
  dateOfLastChange: '2026-10-29'
